annotations.title: Change ideas in a content calendar

description: Change ideas in a content calendar by their number (n) before they are made or posted: title, hook, script, caption, hashtags, posting time, platforms, or removed: true to drop one (false puts it back). Only the fields sent change. Words cannot change once an idea is being made. Cost: Free: no credits.

items.description: The ideas to change, each by its number n; only the fields sent change.
One word, letters, digits or _, with or without #.

removed.description: true takes the idea out; false puts it back.
